analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for the third consecutive session. RSI remains at 43.1 in neutral territory, and while the MACD histogram shows improvement, it is still in a bearish convergence phase. The weekly ADX at 26.4 suggests a clear trend, but the daily ADX at 24.1 indicates an early stage of trend formation, making direction confirmation premature. The 5-day volatility range of -5.98%, +4.14%, -5.61%, -1.01%, and +0.79% shows consolidation after significant swings. The current price of 30,040 KRW is above the swing support at 29,960 KRW, requiring confirmation of support.
